node_definition.done_when: on the forking path (fleet spawn disabled), _start_supervisor double-forks: an intermediate process starts the supervisor in a session of its own and exits at once, so the supervisor's parent is never the launching process, and _start_supervisor still returns the supervisor's own pid (the process group crew stop signals) and still runs _confirm_supervisor_survived on it. The fleet batch-step path is unchanged. A new tests/test_supervisor_outlives_its_launcher.py, with _supervisor_argv patched to a short sleep stub, starts a supervisor from a long-lived child process and asserts that the returned pid is alive, is its own session and process-group leader, and has a parent pid different from the launching process; it also asserts that SIGTERM to the launcher's process group leaves the supervisor alive. It reaps every process it starts. Only the named test files are run, with RECKON_FLEET_SPAWN unset and no call reaching SLURM, each log ending with an EXIT= line; the coordinator runs the wider population at merge. Before status complete, delete every directory you created under /tmp, print what you delete, and list it in artifacts.
